name: flex-carousel
title: Flex Carousel
description: An endless horizontal strip of photo cards where the centre image is sharp and the ones either side stretch and warp like liquid glass. It drifts on its own and can be dragged, scrolled or stepped with keys.
use: A travel, fashion or portfolio gallery where photos should feel like a flowing film strip.
avoid: It is a WebGL canvas with tiny captions, and it captures vertical wheel scrolling by default.
a11y: Arrow keys and Enter work with a visible focus ring; only a live caption names the current card. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A band of photographs runs across a black stage, the middle card at full size and clean while the next cards bow and stretch into curved slivers at the edges. A tiny title, place and counter sit under the centre image.
behaves: The strip slides sideways and settles on a card, the neighbours flexing and smearing with faint colour fringing as they pass. It also advances by itself, and dragging, scrolling, clicking a card or pressing the arrow keys moves it.
customise: Pass items with image, alt, title and subtitle. Preset, intro, card height, gap, radius, fit, lens shape, bend, dispersion and autoplay interval are props.
weight: heavy: Each frame renders cards to a target, then runs a twelve-tap lens shader across the screen.
